text: Remote work sounds isolating to me. I need an office to focus.
We were sent home. I miss the whiteboards and I am not enjoying this.
Funny, I now get more done at home than I ever did in the office.
I asked to stay fully remote. Commuting feels like wasted hours.
Planted tomatoes again. Gardening is the best part of my week.
The courgettes were huge this year, I gave half to the neighbours.
Started seeds indoors in March; gardening keeps me sane.
